story.value: The name osmium comes from the Greek word osme, meaning "smell", because of the sharp odor of its volatile oxide.
Osmium and iridium were discovered at the same time by the British chemist Smithson Tennant in 1803.

uses.value: Osmium is mainly used to make very hard alloys.
Osmium alloys are found in items such as ball point pen tips, fountain pen tips and record player needles.
Osmium is combined with other platinum group metals to make very hard alloys for items such as fountain pen tips and electrical contacts.
